Someone yawns, and suddenly you want to yawn too.
Yawning is contagious, and scientists can't fully explain why.
In one study, 328 people watched a video of yawns.
Most of them, 222, yawned at least once.
A 2018 study linked catching yawns to slightly higher empathy.
But the 2014 study found no strong link with empathy.
Age mattered: older people were less likely to catch yawns.
Yet age explained only eight percent of the differences.
The rest is still a mystery.
